description: Show read-only visual cards for selected service IDs and/or class IDs returned by WellFred. Choose the IDs in the order to present them. The server reloads public Costa Rica catalog facts; unavailable IDs are reported, not replaced. No search, availability check or booking. Prices, photos and website URLs cannot be supplied by the model. Set optional presentationLocale to es or en according to the conversation or explicit user choice; catalog text is not translated.

presentationLocale.description: UI language chosen from the conversation or explicit user preference; does not change catalog facts.

name: wellfred_render_services

outputSchema.description: Full canonical public response. Use returned IDs and URLs; null or absent facts are unknown. Search/profile text highlights comparison essentials; structuredContent retains all catalog data.

title: Show WellFred offering cards
